title: Right continuity of the Gaussian profile at zero
statement: Let $\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian density and $\Phi$ the standard Gaussian distribution function. Define $U(\alpha)=\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(\alpha))$ for $0<\alpha<1$, and $U(\alpha)=0$ otherwise. Then $U(\alpha)\to 0$ as $\alpha\to 0$ through positive values.
hypotheses_covered: The argument approaches $0$ through positive real values.
replaced: Let $\Phi,\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and let $\overline I(p)=\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(p))$ for $0<p<1$, with $\overline I(p)=0$ elsewhere. Then $\lim_{p\to0^+}\overline I(p)=0$.
